name: The invites_enabled installation switch: invite links off unless deployment.private.json says true
summary: admin.invites_enabled reads invites_enabled from deployment.private.json: absent or false is off, true is on, anything else is off with a warning naming the setting. EndpointBackend.get_invites_enabled reads it on every invite request through _read_deployment_setting (an unreadable file is the usual 503); the service-local InProcessBackend has the attribute invites_enabled, False. While off, POST /v1/invites, /v1/invites/view and /v1/invites/redeem answer 403 invites_disabled with the one pinned sentence invites.INVITES_OFF and the create form is hidden; listing and withdrawing stay open. A restore of the HTTP state withdraws the backup's pending invites.
